rule: Default rest by block kind (strength 150 s, hypertrophy 90 s, conditioning 60 s ...)
summary: Hypertrophy rest of 90 s matches the meta-analytic finding of no clear gain beyond ~90 s; strength rest of 150 s is slightly below the 3-5 min that favours strength but applies to secondary work only.

sources.note: Grgic 2017 SR: short and long rest both build muscle; long rest may help trained lifters
Singer 2024 Bayesian MA: small hypertrophy benefit for >60 s rest; no clear difference beyond ~90 s
de Salles 2009 review: 3-5 min rest gives larger absolute strength gains
